integrity: All displayed finite comparisons and KKT certificates use rational arithmetic; no statistical or floating-point evidence is promoted to an exhaustive mathematical result. Historical priority is provisional.
limitations: Exact comparison only for cyclic consecutive-band support patterns with 3 <= n <= 13; no global sharp Birkhoff projection Lipschitz modulus and no arbitrary-support classification.
title: First cyclic-band departure from full-support stability in doubly stochastic least squares
